run_lazyconfig_training: run detectron2 model training using a LazyConfig Python config file with multi-GPU support
run_evaluation_only: run evaluation only on a detectron2 model using a LazyConfig file and a pre-trained checkpoint
run_do_train: run the do_train function to instantiate a model, optimizer, and trainer from a LazyConfig
run_do_test: run the do_test function to evaluate a model on a test dataset using inference_on_dataset
run_invoke_main: run the invoke_main entry point to parse CLI args and launch distributed training across GPUs
